title: Comfort Club Dues Payment Terms: Grace Period, Late Fee, Waivers and Nonpayment Termination
content:
Payment terms on Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements dues are set per tier as follows.

| Tier | Payment grace (calendar days after a dues charge posts) | Late fee per overdue billing period (USD) | Late fees that may be waived in any 12 months | Nonpayment termination (calendar days after an unpaid dues charge posts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 15 | 7.50 | 0 | 60 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 15 | 7.50 | 1 | 60 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 15 | 7.50 | 1 | 60 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 15 | 7.50 | 1 | 60 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 15 | 7.50 | 2 | 60 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 15 | 7.50 | 2 | 60 |

## Terms

- **Payment grace**: the calendar days after a dues charge posts before the agreement becomes past due.
- **Late fee**: the fee charged once per overdue billing period.
- **Waiver allowance**: the number of late fees that may be waived in any 12 months.
- **Nonpayment termination**: the calendar days after an unpaid dues charge posts at which the agreement is terminated.

## How the tiers compare
The grace period (15 days), the late fee (7.50 USD) and the nonpayment termination period (60 days) are identical on all six tiers. The tiers differ only in the waiver allowance: none on Comfort Club Basic, one in any 12 months on Comfort Club Silver, Comfort Club Gold and Comfort Club Platinum, and two on Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home.
